mechanism: NSAIDs reduce renal potassium excretion by decreasing prostaglandin-mediated renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system activity, increasing hyperkalemia risk especially in patients with renal impairment or concurrent ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; avoid concurrent use in patients with renal disease, diabetes, or those taking RAAS inhibitors; use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration.
